findings.failing_input: User clicks save twice rapidly (or save then immediate delete) — items is captured from React state snapshot at commit time
findings.expected: Both writes preserved by reading latest items via functional setState
findings.actual: commit() and remove() both close over the items value captured during render — a second mutation invoked before re-render will compute next based on stale snapshot. Probability is low (single operator, single panel) but not impossible: typing Enter twice in <16ms or click + keyboard Enter overlap could lose an item
findings.fix_sketch: Use setItems(prev => prev.some(x => x.id === a.id) ? prev.map(...) : [a, ...prev]) and similarly for remove(); also pass next via the same callback to writeAnnotations
findings.regression_test_idea: unit test calling commit(newA) then remove(newA.id) back-to-back without awaiting React updates

uncertainty_notes: Hebrew RTL handled with start/end and gradient-to-l. Cloud-sync is via writeAnnotations → pushCloudKey (annotations.ts:89). Custom event roas-annotations-changed used to sync across mounted panels. todayInIsrael() uses Asia/Jerusalem TZ correctly. Form's max=today is computed once per mount (not date-dependent re-render) — acceptable since panel is short-lived. No tests for this component file specifically.
